skill.name: linear
skill.description: Connect AI assistants to Linear issue tracking through GraphQL API workflows for issues, comments, projects, and team states.
skill.summary: Manage Linear issues, comments, projects, and status updates from AI coding workflows.
skill.author: 0xSero

security_audit.summary: Most static detections are Markdown formatting, GraphQL field names, denied sensitive-file patterns, or Linear state labels and were adjudicated as false positives. Confirmed risks remain for bash-driven network requests, Linear API key handling, broad MCP inheritance, and custom endpoint support that could route credentials outside Linear.

remediation.issue: Broad MCP inheritance expands the skill beyond Linear workflows.
remediation.suggestion: Set mcp inheritAll to false and explicitly declare only the MCP servers required for Linear tasks.

remediation.issue: The skill sends LINEAR_API_KEY through curl in an Authorization header.
remediation.suggestion: Warn users to use least-privilege Linear tokens and prevent command logging or prompt echoes that include the header.

remediation.issue: Custom API endpoint support can route credentials away from Linear.
remediation.suggestion: Default to the official Linear endpoint and require explicit user confirmation before using any alternate endpoint.

remediation.issue: Linear operations are performed through general bash and curl instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer a constrained Linear MCP server or typed client wrapper with fixed host validation and parameterized request construction.

semantic_findings.title: Broad MCP Server Inheritance
semantic_findings.description: The skill sets mcp inheritAll to true, which can expose every configured MCP server to a Linear-focused workflow. This expands privileges beyond the stated Linear API integration.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The configuration directly enables inheritance of all MCP servers. The risk depends on the host environment, but the privilege expansion is explicit.

semantic_findings.title: Custom API Endpoint Can Receive Linear Credentials
semantic_findings.description: The skill documents a custom LINEAR_API_URL and also sends LINEAR_API_KEY in an Authorization header. A non-Linear endpoint could receive the token if users or automation route requests there.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file documents custom endpoint support and token-bearing API requests. The example uses the official URL, so exploitation requires endpoint override or misuse.

content.user_title: Manage Linear Issues from AI Workflows
content.value_statement: Teams lose time switching between coding tools and Linear. This skill guides AI assistants through Linear GraphQL workflows for issues, comments, and project updates.
actual_capabilities: Create Linear issues with title, description, team, and priority fields.
Update issue status, priority, estimates, and related issue properties.
Add comments to existing Linear issues through GraphQL mutations.
Query the current Linear user, team states, and project status details.
Summarize completed Linear actions with identifiers, URLs, and changed properties.
limitations: Requires a valid LINEAR_API_KEY and LINEAR_TEAM_ID in the environment.
Requires network access to the Linear GraphQL API.
Provides GraphQL examples, not a packaged Linear client or executable wrapper.
Can only perform actions allowed by the configured Linear API token.

use_cases.title: Create implementation tasks during development
use_cases.description: Turn a bug report or feature request into a Linear issue with priority and team assignment.

use_cases.title: Track project delivery status
use_cases.description: Query Linear project progress and summarize issue counts, completion, and current state.

use_cases.title: Keep backlog discussions current
use_cases.description: Add Linear comments and update issue states after product review or sprint planning.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear issue for this bug report. Use the default team, set priority to High, and return the new identifier and URL.

prompt_templates.title: Update Issue Status
prompt_templates.prompt: Find the available team states, move issue ENG-123 to Done, and summarize the changed fields.

prompt_templates.title: Add a Context Comment
prompt_templates.prompt: Add a comment to ENG-123 with the release note below. Confirm the comment URL after the update completes.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Project Follow-Up
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the project status for the provided Linear project ID, identify unfinished work, and create follow-up issues for the top risks.

output_examples.input: Create a high priority issue for a login timeout bug.
output_examples.output: Linear action completed. Created issue ENG-123 with a high priority and returned the Linear URL for review.

output_examples.input: Move ENG-123 to Done and summarize the update.
output_examples.output: Linear action completed. Updated ENG-123 to the completed state and listed the changed status field.

output_examples.input: Check project progress for the current release project.
output_examples.output: Project status returned with state, progress, total issue count, completed issue count, and project URL.

best_practices: Use a Linear API token with the minimum workspace permissions needed for the task.
Confirm issue identifiers, team IDs, and target states before making mutating requests.
Keep API responses concise and avoid sharing sensitive issue content unless required.
anti_patterns: Do not log, echo, or paste the Linear API key into prompts or issue comments.
Do not use a custom API endpoint unless the user has verified it is trusted.
Do not run broad updates across many issues without an explicit user request.

faq.question: What does this skill connect to?
faq.answer: It connects AI assistants to the Linear GraphQL API for issue and project workflows.

faq.question: Which credentials are required?
faq.answer: The skill expects LINEAR_API_KEY and LINEAR_TEAM_ID to be available in the environment.

faq.question: Can it create and update Linear issues?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill includes GraphQL mutations for issue creation, status updates, and comments.

faq.question: Does it include a standalone application?
faq.answer: No. It provides assistant instructions and GraphQL request patterns rather than a packaged application.

faq.question: Can it read project status?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes a project status query for state, progress, issue counts, and project URL.

faq.question: Is it safe to use with a full workspace token?
faq.answer: A limited token is safer. Use the smallest Linear permissions that support the requested workflow.
